temp.old-files.name: Old temporary files
temp.old-files.line: Temporary files apps no longer need
temp.old-files.what: Working files apps put in your Mac's temporary folders and did not clean up, untouched for at least a week.
temp.old-files.made-by: Many apps and tools; an item's name often says which.
temp.old-files.if-removed: They go to the Trash; apps keep their real data elsewhere.
temp.old-files.comes-back: Apps make new ones as they work, and your Mac also clears these folders on its own.
temp.enabled.label: Temporary files
temp.enabled.description: Finds old working files in your Mac's temporary folders that apps did not clean up.
temp.older-than-days.label: Offer temporary files unchanged for
temp.older-than-days.description: Anything changed more recently is kept. It cannot be set below 7 days.
temp.finding.title: {name}
temp.finding.reason-user: In your temporary folder, unchanged for {days} days.
temp.finding.reason-shared: In the shared temporary folder, unchanged for {days} days. A restart clears it too.
temp.left-out.system: It belongs to the system or another user; removing it needs an administrator.
temp.left-out.locked: It is locked. To let Fresher remove it, unlock it in Finder's Get Info.
temp.left-out.app-open: It belongs to an app that is open. Quit the app and scan again.
temp.left-out.special: A running program uses it to talk to another program, so it is kept.
temp.left-out.lock: A program uses it to mark something as in use, so it is kept.
temp.left-out.recent: Changed or read recently; an app may still be using it. Your Mac clears these on its own when it can.
temp.left-out.no-system: Fresher could not list your open apps, so it keeps everything. Scan again.
